The driver describes a short period of unresponsiveness after a delayed lunch and believes it was a low glucose episode because he uses insulin, but the witness says his hand twitched before he stopped speaking and cannot remember whether he answered immediately after a sweet drink. No glucose was measured until approximately 25 minutes later, when it was 4.8 mmol/L, and the nurse has no contemporaneous clinical record confirming hypoglycaemia, a seizure or another cause.
